Projects / Health Longevity Service

Pilot Project on Health Longevity Service

A health initiative for people over 60, women and other community members, with healthy and dignified ageing at its centre.

Services

  • Health check-up
  • Blood pressure
  • Blood sugar
  • Video X-ray
  • Geriatrics
  • Gynecology
  • Pulmonary Function Test
  • Respiratory consultation
